summary: Added server-loaded Jetty handler in new solr:jetty-metrics module; bounded HTTP method and response-class counters, active requests, Jetty pool current/idle/max/queue gauges. The handler implements a JDK Supplier snapshot passed through a servlet context attribute to SolrMetricManager; CoreContainerProvider owns and closes callbacks. Wired distribution Jetty XML and JettySolrRunner, added integration test and documentation/changelog. XML parsing and git diff --check passed. No Gradle or execution on Windows. New module lockfile and dependency/license metadata remain ungenerated and must be obtained on Linux; formatting may require repair. No claim of compile, production startup or readiness. Async, lifecycle, disabled metrics and full matrix require further tests.
